title: Ask HN: What do AI improvements at these labs look like?
excerpt: I'm struggling to understand what improvements at labs look like. Some part of it is more training data, more weights, more post training. That all seems.straightforward to me. But what % of improvements come from that as opposed to techniques and model design changes? MoE stuff, swapping out the activation function, etc etc?
